name: JJC8-091
summary: JJC8-091 is an atypical dopamine reuptake inhibitor (DRI) that was derived from modafinil. It is a lead compound for potential treatment of psychostimulant use disorder (PSUD) and is under development by Encepheal Therapeutics for use as a pharmaceutical drug.

pharmacology.text: JJC8-091 is an atypical dopamine reuptake inhibitor (DRI) that was derived from modafinil. The affinity (Ki) of JJC8-091 for the dopamine transporter (DAT) is 230 to 289 nM. It has substantially higher affinity for the DAT than modafinil (Ki = 2,600–8,160 nM).

uses.text: It is a lead compound for potential treatment of psychostimulant use disorder (PSUD) and is under development by Encepheal Therapeutics for use as a pharmaceutical drug. In any case, modafinil and novel analogues like JJC8-091 are of interest in the potential treatment of PSUD.
